item.title: Apple Launches M5 Ultra & M6: Quad‑Die + 2nm Power
item.description: Apple's new M5 Ultra and M6 chips debut in Mac Studio and Mac mini, featuring a quad‑die M5 Ultra architecture and the industry's first 2nm silicon.
